summary: Backend and frontend testing of User Intelligence system completed successfully. All 16 backend tests pass (16/16). All admin intelligence endpoints (GET /admin/users/{id}/intelligence with period filters, /intelligence/pdf, /full-export, /admin/intelligence/global), plus tracking endpoints (POST /track/session, POST /track/event) work as specified. Auth guards return proper 401/403. Frontend User Intelligence page loads perfectly with all 7 sections (Overview, Engagement, Atlas AI, Learning, Features, Revenue, Timeline), 4 period tabs, engagement score display (49/100 Moderate), summary card, and score breakdown bars. PDF download triggers a valid file (mentova_intelligence_*.pdf). Section switching works.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, use 'boxShadow'; Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (non-blocking, cosmetic warnings only)

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW-PRIORITY: data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity components in /app/frontend/app/user/intelligence.tsx (e.g., download-pdf-btn, section-engagement, period-7 etc.) are NOT reaching the rendered DOM. React Native Web strips unknown props. Consider using RN's `testID` prop instead (RN Web will map testID -> data-testid automatically on native View elements), or add web-only props. This does not affect functionality but reduces automated test robustness.
critical_code_review_comments: user_intelligence.py is ~880 lines - consider splitting PDF generation and full-export helpers into separate modules for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

TTL index at line 877 (`user_events.create_index('timestamp', expireAfterSeconds=...)`) conflicts with the earlier index on 'timestamp' at line 875 (same key, different options). MongoDB may raise IndexOptionsConflict and log a warning; the code catches it but the TTL may not be applied. Fix by using only one index with expireAfterSeconds.
Endpoint POST /api/track/session returns 200 with {success: false} on missing auth rather than 401, which is inconsistent with the rest of the API. Consider returning proper status codes.
Field 'success' in intelligence response has no error branch - errors are raised as HTTPException, which is fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all sections load, PDF downloads, navigation works)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin user data
context_for_next_testing_agent: User Intelligence feature is fully functional. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_user_intelligence.py covers all endpoints. If the data-testid concern needs fixing, main agent should replace `data-testid=` with `testID=` on RN components (React Native Web automatically converts testID to data-testid on rendered DOM elements).
